paragraphs: Rav Tuvi bar Mattana sent before Rav Yosef: Chullin 39b; Bava Kamma 36b (there, Rav Tuvyah bar Mattana). Chezkat HaBatim, Bava Batra 58a: a magus who dug up the dead reached Rav Tuvi bar Mattana's cave, and he seized him by his beard. Abaye came and asked him to release him, and he did. The next year he returned and was seized by his beard. Abaye asked him, but he did not release him until he cut off his beard. Bava Batra 151a, near the end: Rav Tuvi bar Rav Mattana's sister conveyed her property to him in the morning. Toward evening Rav Achdevui bar Rav Mattana came and told her, “Now they will say that this Master is a Torah scholar and that Master is not.” She conveyed it to him. He came before Rav Nachman, etc. Apparently this Rav Mattana had only these two sons: otherwise why did the others not come when their sister conveyed her property to these two? Yet there are Rav Adda bar Mattana, R. Ammi bar Mattana, Rav Huna bar Mattana, and R. Chiyya bar Mattana. One must say this later Mattana is called Rav Mattana. A butcher acted insolently toward him, and Abaye and Rava placed him under a ban: Moed Katan 16a. He transmitted a teaching in R. Yoshiyah’s name: Temurah 29a.
